title: The God of Abraham Praise
author: Daniel ben Judah (circa 1400)
credit: Daniel ben Judah, circa 1400. Paraphrased by Thomas Olivers, circa 1765.
verses: Ancient of everlasting days, and God of Love;
I bow and bless the sacred Name forever blessed.
From earth I rise and seek the joys at His right hand;
And Him my only Portion make, my Shield and Tow'r.
Shall guide me all my happy days, in all my ways.
He calls a worm His friend,
And He shall save me to the end, thro' Jesus' blood.
I shall, on eagle wings upborne, to Heav'n ascend.
And sing the wonders of His grace forevermore.
To Canaan's bounds I urge my way, at His command.
And thro' the howling wilderness my way pursue.
